claim: User is a core domain entity persisted via the prisma model User.
UserRepository is an interface implemented by PrismaUserRepository (production) and InMemoryUserRepository (test).
AuthenticationService is a domain service exposing authentication results and depends on a PasswordHasher abstraction.
AuthorizationService implements role-based access control and defines Permission and AuthorizationError in the application layer.
InMemoryUserRepository is an in-memory UserRepository implementation used for tests/mirage, not production persistence.
LoginForm is a presentation component that submits credentials and consumes a LoginResponse.
prisma/schema.prisma defines model User as the persistence schema for the User entity.
Auth API surface consists of POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout and GET /api/auth/session routes.
